Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server: New regions now available in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server (public preview) is now available in the East Asia, Germany West Central, Korea South, South Central US, and UK West regions. With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server to these regions, you can now enjoy a simplified provisioning experience with: 

  • Optimized lower total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKU 
  • Access to the stop/start feature
  • Better resiliency with zone redundant high availability in selected regions
  • More control with scheduled maintenance 
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption
  • The openness of the Postgres database community version   

Read the documentation to learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server and visit the Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server availability by region section to learn more about regional availability.
